in_sanskrit.name: मुकुन्द
in_sanskrit.meaning: God of Wealth, Giver of Boons
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: मुक् (muk) - to release from, to free + कु (kun) - to do + द (da) - to give. In Hindu mythology, Mukunda is a name of Vishnu, who is the giver of boons and the god of wealth. He is also considered as the one who releases one from the cycle of birth and death.

in_hindi.name: मुकुन्द
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुकु (muku) - सेवक, परिकर्द्ध + न्द (nd) - विशेष Mukunda in Hindi is a name of a devoted servant or a special one.

in_tamil.name: முகுந்த
in_tamil.long_meaning: வலு (valu) - ஓர் காலையில் அமையாத மக்களுக்கள் Mukunda in Tamil is a name of a person who is always present at the hour of need.

in_telugu.name: ముగున్ద
in_telugu.long_meaning: ముగు (mugu) - పరిశోద్శమైన Mukunda in Telugu is a name of a person who is dear to everyone.

in_marathi.name: Mukund
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Liberator, God of Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mukund हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mukund is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘muk’, which means freedom or liberation from suffering. The suffix ‘und’ means god or deity. Mukund is also known as the god of wealth and prosperity in Hinduism.
